verdict.rationale: A tax-agency web service could plausibly offer natural-language operation, such as an assistant or chatbot for filing and payments, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no evidence of any natural-language command interface. The probes only record Akamai 403 walls at the front door and at the MyFTB/Web Pay host, which says nothing about natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
